# THP-for-Good

> Embedded Miniapps Boilerplate (Circles) — Next.js 16 + shadcn/ui (Base UI) + TypeScript starter for building Circles miniapps, evolved into the THP-for-Good app: landing, expert profiles, booking, DAO, stats, admin. Host pushes the wallet via iframe (no connect button); the SDK handles transactions and signing. Light theme only; pnpm; Turbopack default. Durable docs English; chat with the operator French.

## Root

- [README.md](README.md): Repository overview — quickstart, wallet connection, playground testing, marketplace listing
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent guide — stack rules (Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, light-only theme), SDK pitfalls, project structure
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code-oriented notes
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines (multi-contributor repo — PRs to `dev`, no direct pushes)

## App routes

- [app/page.tsx](app/page.tsx): Dashboard — ConnectionCard, SignInDemo, NavCards
- [app/landing/page.tsx](app/landing/page.tsx): Marketing landing — senior-polish editorial bands, ochre promise section, Join-the-chain CTA, Circles owl watermarks
- [app/profile/page.tsx](app/profile/page.tsx): Profile lookup page
- [app/expert/[id]/page.tsx](app/expert/[id]/page.tsx): Expert profile page — share button (Web Share fallback), contextual tooltips, opaque slugs, SEO/AI metadata
- [app/expert/register/page.tsx](app/expert/register/page.tsx): Expert registration flow
- [app/api/bookings](app/api/bookings): Booking API routes — post-pay hardening, FK split mentors/experts
- [app/actions/page.tsx](app/actions/page.tsx): `sendTransactions` code sample
- [app/stats/page.tsx](app/stats/page.tsx): Stats / analytics views
- [app/admin/page.tsx](app/admin/page.tsx): Admin panel (admin-wallet gated)
- [app/dao/page.tsx](app/dao/page.tsx): DAO views
- [app/calls/page.tsx](app/calls/page.tsx): Calls views
- [app/history/page.tsx](app/history/page.tsx): History views
- [app/about/page.tsx](app/about/page.tsx): About page
